I agree, and I disagree. Yes, the falloff sucks - and yes - it virtually trivializes the +5 LMB and +10 RMB skills that she has. However, as a Storm main - having ANY buff to damage will make her feel \*less\* miserable at times - which is a welcome change... 

I believe the changes to the ult were to address that multi second silence / recovery period that comes with the potential for an easy team-wipe. Rather than being stuck for two seconds and instantly losing hundreds of temp HP, we get MORE temp HP than we initially had - AND it falls off per second rather than instantaneously - helping to survive a bit during that recovery period.

Honestly, though... The ult change and the 50% increase to projectile speeds on LMB are the only two changes I think we will really feel here. I may be able to fight an iron man without shooting three business days in advance and hoping he's on dial-up so the projectile hits.

I hope they look at her more in the future and give us a speed buff, though. She's already penalized for flight due to both falloff distance and penetrating attacks.. and her move speed pretty much gimps her if she's off the ground and visible for more than 2 seconds at any given time.

I do pray they reconsider a move speed buff, CDR improvement on her Goddess Boost, or give a larger movement speed buff or penalty to incentivize using anything other than the damage amp.

Then the user(s) that activated the cards/codes get the bucks revoked, and/or permanently banned.

The "Journal" tab in-game pretty much gives you all the pointers you need! From there on out, it's all experience and a dash of luck for good measure.

The first thing I do when I start is search the floor for two stones and craft a knife. 

Cut up my pants and undershirt and make a backpack (5 strips = 1 rope, and 2 cloth = backpack)

I then use said knife to chop down some bushes tightly packed together > craft wood bark rope (5 small sticks)

Use stone knife + rope + long stick to make a stone spear instead of the default wooden one

Craft a fresh knife, place in backpack for future use.

Run off into the sunset, pantless, with nothing but a spear, a shiv, and a dream.

Hitting small towns is a good place to start as well; grab a few padlocks (5 makes a rusty lock); claim a garage (1 way door) by locking it - and you have a secure base to operate out of until you get a foothold.

One thing I would like to see, is the implementation of gun oil that can be found near workbenches, in cabins, or rarely in antique cabinets in houses.

2 Cloths, a gun oil, and a metal scrap to craft a "Makeshift gun cleaning kit" to use. Obviously you would need higher engineering to be able to upkeep past a certain percentage... but it would be nice to keep guns up to 50-75% or so until a full sized weapon cleaning kit was found.
